title: node:worker_threads Worker
executor: 4 worker threads (node:worker_threads); the main thread's event loop hands out jobs
notes: Runtime baseline: four new Worker(file) from node:worker_threads, each handed the next [index, seed, rounds] by postMessage as soon as it answers, results placed by index, then terminate() on each. The runtimes have no pool type; four workers fed from a shared counter are the pool, as Go's goroutines and Ruby's threads are in thread-pool-map.
